name: association-hub
description: Member management and email communication platform for associations

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:setup: pnpm db:start && sleep 3 && pnpm --filter database prisma:generate && pnpm --filter database prisma:migrate && pnpm --filter database prisma:seed
scripts.setup: pnpm install && cp .env.example .env && cp .env.example packages/database/.env && pnpm db:setup
